name: Stepper
purpose: The interactive multi-step flow driver (Progress-tracker is display-only): step content panels, validation-gated Next, back-navigation on completed dots, and the same dots↔track responsive collapse. Back/Next ride the Mono button ladder as the journey's real actions. Itinerary row 34 (P1); built Phase-2 wave 2 (worker A continuation).

props.name: steps
props.$note: Name + panel per step; the dots render from it, the collapsed head shows 'Step n of m' + the step title.

props.name: gate
props.$note: Next runs the current step's validator; failure = field error + focus, no advance (3.3.1).

props.name: backNavigation
props.$note: Completed dots are real buttons; current and future steps are never clickable.

variants.name: wide (dots)
variants.use: Progress-tracker's dots stepper — 28px dots, 4px connector, done = fill + check, current = inset ring; done dots become buttons.

variants.name: narrow (track)
variants.use: ≤520px container: the 1784-86051 head + continuous 4px track (same collapse as Progress-tracker).

$consumes: Progress-tracker (dots + track visuals — change them THERE; receipt-flagged duplication, fold-or-partial question queued)
Button ladder (Back = quaternary ghost, Next = primary)

tokens.steps: step/complete + progress/incomplete + background/default as the mark (was progress/complete under R-D22: 'progress is STRUCTURE — ink pair, never status colour'; REBOUND #175 by s175-D1. R-D22's ink rule now belongs to progress/complete alone, which measures a continuous quantity.) #176 (WORKING, awaiting Dave's eye): step/complete INHERITS THE SUCCESS-ROUNDEL SYSTEM WHOLESALE — it aliases rag/success, so Mono reads #66CC8D and Console/Supercharge read #5DAC7B, all mode-invariant, each from its own palette rather than a copied hex. LEGACY IS THE ONE EXCEPTION: its ERROR red #A8000B in light, #FFFFFF in dark. The mark moved with the system too — the check glyph KNOCKS TO THE PAGE (background/default) instead of the white-fixed text/on-inverse. The #175 'UNDECIDED for Mono/Console/Supercharge' park is discharged. RETIRED values, quoted: Mono/Console ink pair #1A1A1A|#FFFFFF, Legacy #DB0011, Supercharge #B92F1E|#CC4333; mark was text/on-inverse #FFFFFF|#333333. | #176 REFINEMENTS RULED OFF THE RENDERED v1 REVIEW PAGE (which outranks the chat legs): LEGACY LIGHT IS THE PRIMARY RED #DB0011, not the error red — Dave: 'Use the primary red for Legacy.' Sequence by addition: #DB0011 (s175) -> #A8000B (chat, self-corrected) -> #DB0011 (ruled off the page). Dark #FFFFFF untouched. THE MARK IS DARK INK, NOT THE PAGE: --on-complete now binds the NEW token step/on-complete, #1A1A1A mode-invariant — Dave: 'Apollo mono, in the same way as the roundels, uses the dark ink colour for the glyphs.' That is the s122-D2 mark camp, and Mono/Console/Supercharge all already declare #1A1A1A for the success roundel mark (verified first-hand in their marks blocks). Legacy overrides: #FFFFFF light (its own roundel mark, s122-D5) and #1A1A1A dark as a DECLARED EXCEPTION, because Legacy's dark step fill is #FFFFFF and an exact match would be a white tick on a white disc — that leg is NOT RULED by Dave and is flagged for him. RETIRED: the knock-to-page mark, background/default, #FFFFFF light / #1A1A1A dark. THE TICK IS THE THICK ASSET status-icons/yes-thick.svg (was status-icons/yes.svg) — 'Please use the thick tick icon for all'. CONTRAST DOCTRINE, Dave verbatim: 'the intent/meaning is carried by the glyph a label ... the label and the symbol must carry the contrast not the decoration.' GATED: tick-on-fill (3:1) and label-on-page (4.5:1). DECLARED ABSENCE: fill-on-page, fill-on-track.
tokens.field: form/background|border sets (Input-fields lock-step); error = rag/error (R-D20), message text stays text/default
tokens.motion: component-type/button-family/press-travel + press-darken (B-D7) on .st-nav buttons — injection pending conductor registration

mustNotNeighbour: A second progress indicator for the same flow (one source of step truth)

behaviour.advance: Next validates the current step; failure errors the field and focuses it (no advance); success advances and moves focus to the new panel's heading. Last step relabels Next→Confirm.
behaviour.back: Back button or any completed dot returns to that step (values retained); Back disabled on step 1.
behaviour.collapse: Same container-query breakpoint as Progress-tracker (520px): dots ↔ head+track, one state drives both renderings.
behaviour.announcements: A persistent sr-only aria-live region announces every step change ('Step n of m: name') — whichever rendering is visible (Progress-tracker pattern).

accessibility.structure: Steps in an <ol> (sequence semantics); aria-current=step on the current li; done dots = real buttons with 'Go back to step n (completed)' labels; panels are labelled sections; collapsed form = role=progressbar with aria-valuetext.
accessibility.focus: Programmatic focus to the new panel heading (tabindex=-1) on every navigation — context change is announced and located (2.4.3); gated failure focuses the field.
accessibility.colour: Done/current are never colour-alone: check glyph, ring, weight, aria state all carry it (1.4.1). Progress = ink (R-D22).
accessibility.$note: 3.2.2 met (Next is the only advance trigger — typing never navigates) but out of relatedSC: not in the compliance lookup (Form-layout precedent).

antiPatterns: Clickable FUTURE steps (skipping unvalidated steps breaks the gate; only completed steps navigate).
Disabling Next instead of validating on press (errors must be announced, not silently prevented — Form-layout precedent).
Status colours on step state (progress is STRUCTURE = ink pair, R-D22).
A second stepper/progress bar for the same flow.
Local press-physics CSS on .st-nav buttons (ADR-0013: injected partial only).
Press physics on dot buttons (structural navigation markers, the Tabs class).

tokenValidation.result: PASS — new build, no deprecated tokens: step visuals = progress/complete|incomplete + text/on-inverse (R-D22 set), field = live form/* + R-D20 rag/error, buttons = Mono ladder, radius = control + indicator roles, motion = component-type/button-family params (values byte-identical to Button's blocks).
tokenValidation.$note: Consumed state weight-shifts from Progress-tracker (.dot 500, current label 500, count 500) on composite-bound text — the Input-fields is-completed precedent; receipt-noted.
